title: Church leaders: A Problem Well Stated
description: Church leaders  Success cannot be defined by attention, production value, or programs.
content:
## Church leaders

Success cannot be defined by attention, production value, or programs. Audit where the attractional model — church growth by staging ever-more-compelling experiences — has metastasized in your context, and note where Sunday's message is filtered by audience capture. Consider counterweights that restore honest speech — such as balancing career preaching with visiting ministers who are independent enough to say hard, existentially important truths.
